feeds.title: Jacobson Plastic Surgery Blog
feeds.description: Dr. Steven R. Jacobson's skills as a plastic surgeon became quite apparent while training at the Mayo Clinic in Rochester, MN. A lifelong Minnesota native, Dr. Jacobson earned his medical degree at the University of Minnesota before taking a surgical residency position at Mayo. Even among the best of the best he was an outlier, winning a prestigious Foundation Scholar fellowship to train in Australia under Dr. Bryan Mendelson, the world's leading authority on facial anatomy.

feeds.title: George H. Landis, MD Blog
feeds.description: Board-certified Minneapolis plastic surgeon, Dr. Landis, offers knowledge, decades of experience, and ethical standards for professionalism and medical excellence. Working closely with his patients, Dr. Landis builds a partnership to achieve optimal aesthetic results while improving self-image and quality of life. If you're looking for a plastic surgeon in Minneapolis-St. Paul, Dr. Landis encourages you to browse his website for more information about his background and available procedures. When you're ready for an in-person consultation, contact our office for an appointment.

feeds.title: Kobienia Plastic Surgery Blog
